definitions.explanation: A wooden tower structure, historically part of castle fortifications or used as a watchtower.
A temporary elevated platform or scaffold, especially one used for taiko drumming at festivals.

examples.english: I can see the castle turret.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{櫓|やぐら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This turret was built in the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{石垣|いしがき}→石垣：19673_ishigaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦そびえる→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧{櫓|やぐら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面影|おもかげ}→面影：06631_omokage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}している→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: The turret rising above the stone wall retains traces of the past.
To play the taiko drum on the scaffold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{櫓|やぐら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てられた→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧。
examples.english: The festival scaffold was erected in the plaza.

examples.japanese: ⟦{盆踊|ぼんおど}り→盆踊り：05638_bonodori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{櫓|やぐら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A scaffold was set up in the center of the Bon dance venue.

notes:
WRITING:
The kanji {櫓|やぐら} is complex and sometimes written in hiragana.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Sense 1: Castle {櫓|やぐら} served as watchtowers and defensive positions. Many survive as historical landmarks.
Sense 2: At ⟦{盆踊|ぼんおど}り→盆踊り：05638_bonodori⟧ (Bon dance) festivals, a wooden {櫓|やぐら} is erected in the center of the dance area, often with taiko drummers performing on top while dancers circle around it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{櫓|やぐら} (castle turret)
- {火|ひ}の{見|み}{櫓|やぐら} (fire watchtower)
- ⟦{盆踊|ぼんおど}り→盆踊り：05638_bonodori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{櫓|やぐら} (Bon dance scaffold)
